name: zwoelva Restaurant & Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**zwoelva Restaurant & Bar** in **Neustift im Stubaital** – a cozy alpine retreat where tradition meets modern flair. Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, this charming spot invites you to savor authentic **Tiroler** hospitality with a twist.

Indulge in hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or fresh trout from the **Inn**, all crafted with local ingredients. The rustic yet refined ambiance, paired with a carefully curated selection of craft beers and fine wines, makes every meal an experience.

After dinner, unwind at the sleek bar, where expert mixologists craft cocktails with regional spirits. Whether you're exploring the **Stubaital** or seeking a peaceful escape, **zwoelva** promises unforgettable moments—just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and the stunning **Karwendel** mountains.
